message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code only reads local files via open() and csv.DictReader; there is no remote data fetching and therefore no checksum verification or source authentication.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only assigns binary labels (0 or 1) based on the 'M_' prefix convention with no validation of label distributions, comparison against expected sets, or noise detection tools.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data loading and preparation code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained weights or serialized model, and there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in the provided snippet.

No detected label distribution validation: The code loads and parses labels but performs no class balance checks, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on label distributions before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard TensorFlow/Keras without any differential privacy library (e.g., TensorFlow Privacy, Opacus) or DP-SGD mechanisms.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or robustness stress tests are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV files and processes tokens without any shape/range validation, schema enforcement, or rejection of malformed inputs before passing data to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks for NaN values, probability bounds, or calibrated thresholds are visible in the inference data-flow path shown.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it is a sequence-labeling (metaphor detection) model using BiLSTM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
